changelog: Cloud-brain privacy isolation. Clipboard capture now redacts secrets (passwords, keys, cards, SSNs) and skips password-manager and banking apps. A hard 'never send to cloud' guarantee: secret patterns are stripped from every cloud-bound prompt, and whole categories (clipboard + screen by default) plus any item you lock stay on-device even if you route private tasks to a cloud brain. New 'Cloud brain isolation' section in Settings and a per-item lock in the captures browser.
